description: NaNb₂PO₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.87 Å. There are four inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-20°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.23 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NbO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-23°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.17 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NbO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-20°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.15 Å. In the fourth Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NbO₆ octahedra and corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-23°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-34°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-25°. There are three shorter (1.54 Å) and one longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond length. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Nb atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Nb atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms.
